goal: Mia (drawn young, about five years old) stands in a sunny meadow with a wooden fence, a small pond, a low tree, and tall grass and points at a gray cat that sits on the wooden fence. No letters, words, or numbers anywhere.
colorPrompt: Compose one children's book picture from the element pictures. Picture 1 shows the girl Mia: the four 3D views at the bottom are the approved character, and the flat drawing at the top is only a hint, so copy the 3D look; ignore the gray background, the labels, and the shadow. Picture 2 is the empty sunny meadow: green grass, a low wooden fence of light-brown posts and two rails across the back at the left and the middle, one low round green tree with a thick trunk and one low branch that reaches to the right, a small round pond with stones and two round lily pads at the right, tall green grass clumps at the lower left and lower right, ONE sun in the upper right, two small clouds, and a blue sky; use it as the background and keep the same meadow; the sun stays the only sun, so draw no second sun. Picture 3 shows the plain gray cat with a lighter chest, pink ear insides, and big green eyes; draw ONE cat, exactly this cat. Keep the soft, round, bright 3D render look of the pictures, not a 2D drawing and no outlines. The children keep their chibi proportions: a big head and a small body. Hands are small, clean hands with five clear short fingers (four fingers and one thumb) when open, never fists unless stated, and a hanging hand shows relaxed, separate short fingers. Rendering errors to NOT copy from the character pictures: a tiny dark tick mark or pale skin flap at the outer corner of an eye, and a faint pale crease on a forehead. Each eye ends in a smooth, rounded corner; no character here has an eyelash flick. Clean eye corners, no streak on the forehead, no marks on the face. The ears are smooth, with one clean rounded rim. Each piece of clothing is one even color with no pale patches, no pale blotches at the shoulders, and no stains. Do not change anyone's skin tone, hair, or clothes. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no writing on any picture or sign. The picture is for young children and is rated G. Keep each character exactly as in the pictures: Mia: a five-year-old girl with a chibi look (a big head and a small body), light-brown shoulder-length hair with a small pink bow on the side, big brown eyes, a pink T-shirt, blue denim overalls, white shoes. The picture: Mia points at the gray cat that sits on the wooden fence. A medium-wide shot at a low camera height in the sunny meadow (picture 2), the whole body of Mia in view. Mia stands in the left half of the picture, turned about three quarters toward the right, smiles with an open mouth, and points with the index finger of one hand at the cat; her other hand hangs relaxed with five short fingers. The ONE plain gray cat (picture 3; no stripes) sits upright on top of the wooden fence at the right of the picture, whole, looking toward Mia; the fence runs across the middle of the picture and is low enough for the cat to sit on its top rail. The pond and the low tree stay in the background. Exactly one girl and one cat. Exactly the characters named here are in the picture, and no other person or animal. A character of the pictures that this description does not name must not appear. Every named character has a clear, whole, friendly face. The page text is "I can see a cat." and is context only: do not draw any text.
linePrompt: Picture 1 is a 3D-rendered children's book picture. Convert picture 1 to line art for a student book: thick, even black lines (about three times a normal outline), simple closed shapes that a 5-year-old can color, on pure white. No blush circles, no eyelash ticks, no hair strands, no shading, no gray, no texture lines, no text. Keep every shape in the same place and the same size. Draw each eye as a closed outline with a big solid black pupil (a filled black circle) inside it. Draw the mouth exactly as in picture 1: an open mouth stays an open mouth drawn as a closed outline, and a closed smile stays one curve. Draw each hand as a closed outline with each finger as a separate rounded shape. Each head of hair is one closed shape. The ear is one closed outline with at most one inner curve. No lines on the clothes other than the outline, the collar, the cuffs, the buttons, the straps, the stripes, and the pocket. No wrinkle lines on any face. Simplify the background: draw only a few large, simple, closed shapes (the ground line, each fence post and each fence rail as a closed shape, the pond as one closed oval with a few big closed stone shapes and each lily pad as one closed oval, the tree as one closed trunk shape with one closed cloud crown, the sun as one closed circle, one or two closed cloud shapes, and each clump of tall grass as one closed cloud-like tuft shape). No grass blades, no small leaves, no flowers, no hatching, no tick marks, no wood grain lines, no cloud details. Every outline is one closed line that never runs into a background line; no loose line ends anywhere. Every line inside an object ends on another line. Use few background shapes. Mia's hair is one closed shape and her pink bow is one closed shape; her overalls keep the two straps and the bib pocket as closed shapes. Each hand is one closed outline with five fingers drawn as separate rounded closed shapes (four fingers and one thumb). Each animal is one closed outline with no fur strands; each ear, tail, wing, and fin is a closed shape; each eye is one closed outline with a big solid black pupil. The cat has three thick whisker lines on each side and no stripes.
